stem: Based on the documented clinical criteria for tonsillectomy, how many episodes of tonsillitis must a child have in a single 12-month period to be considered for surgery?
explanation: To justify tonsillectomy based on a single year of illness, the child must have had at least seven well-documented episodes.
rationale: The number is higher than five for a single-year observation period.

optionExplanations.A: Three episodes per year is the threshold used if the infections have been occurring consistently for at least three consecutive years.
optionExplanations.B: Five episodes per year is the threshold for consideration if the frequency has been maintained for two consecutive years.
optionExplanations.C: To justify tonsillectomy based on a single year of illness, the child must have had at least seven well-documented episodes.
optionExplanations.D: While ten episodes certainly meet the criteria, the minimum standard established for a 12-month period is seven.

source.hint: The number is higher than five for a single-year observation period.
